scripts.build: uv run --locked python -m compileall -q src evals
scripts.lint: uv run --locked ruff check src tests evals ../../packages/contracts/internal-agent/v1/generate.py ../../packages/contracts/internal-agent/v2/generate.py
scripts.typecheck: uv run --locked mypy src tests evals
scripts.eval:offline: uv run --locked pytest tests/test_eval_cases.py tests/test_eval_compare.py tests/test_calendar_context.py tests/test_pydantic_runtime.py
scripts.eval:real: PYTHONPATH=src uv run --locked --group dev python -m evals.run
scripts.eval:compare: PYTHONPATH=src uv run --locked --group dev python -m evals.compare
